rows.id: pe:data-policy:deletion:01
rows.title: Data policy > Deletion
rows.text: Deleting an Evaluation removes its Writing Sample, Findings, Suggestions, and metadata, and Progress recalculates without that evidence. There are no application-managed backups, so deletion cannot be undone through the product. Introducing backups later requires a new explicit policy.

rows.id: pe:data-policy:external-transmission:01
rows.title: Data policy > External transmission
rows.text: Evaluating sends the full current Writing Sample to OpenRouter, routed to `openai/gpt-5.6-terra` with `store: false`, no tools, and no conversation state. The provider receives only that sample, the rubric instructions, and structural annotations.

rows.id: pe:data-policy:external-transmission:02
rows.title: Data policy > External transmission
rows.text: OpenRouter says prompt retention is opt-in and off by default, but the routed model provider has its own logging and retention policy. **This is not a fully local evaluation, and the product must never describe it as one.** See [OpenRouter data collection](https://openrouter.ai/docs/guides/privacy/data-collection) and [provider logging](https://openrouter.ai/docs/guides/privacy/provider-logging).

rows.id: pe:data-policy:external-transmission:03
rows.title: Data policy > External transmission
rows.text: No telemetry or remote analytics.

rows.id: pe:data-policy:local-access-boundary:01
rows.title: Data policy > Local access boundary
rows.text: The application has no authentication, so it must stay host-only. Compose publishes to IPv4 loopback explicitly. The server also rejects unexpected Host headers and cross-origin state-changing requests — loopback binding alone does not stop a hostile web page from driving the local app. CORS is off.

rows.id: pe:data-policy:never-stored:01
rows.title: Data policy > Never stored
rows.text: API keys or other credentials, hidden model reasoning, raw HTTP request or response bodies, unstructured provider output after validation.

rows.id: pe:data-policy:never-stored:02
rows.title: Data policy > Never stored
rows.text: Credentials are read server-side from `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` through Effect Config/Redacted. They never reach browser code, history, or logs. Request logging excludes Writing Sample text and provider bodies.

rows.id: pe:data-policy:stored-locally:01
rows.title: Data policy > Stored locally
rows.text: A successful Evaluation stays in local SQLite until deliberately deleted. No expiration.

rows.id: pe:data-policy:stored-locally:02
rows.title: Data policy > Stored locally
rows.text: Original Writing Sample and its content hash; submission and evaluation timestamps; corrected version and summary; evaluated English word count; score and band; Findings (category, severity, original text, Correction, explanation); Suggestions (original text, optional alternative, context explanation); provider, model, Rubric Version; token usage and latency when the provider reports them.

rows.title: FR-01
rows.text: The full journey — submit, inspect, browse, Progress, delete — works in a browser on the Linux host.

rows.id: pe:requirement:FR-02
rows.title: FR-02
rows.text: Inbound traffic is accepted through host loopback only.

rows.title: FR-03

rows.id: pe:requirement:FR-04

rows.text: Only deliberately submitted text is sent or stored. No background capture.

rows.id: pe:requirement:FR-06
rows.title: FR-06
rows.text: The exact submitted bytes are stored and returned unnormalized.

rows.id: pe:requirement:FR-07
rows.title: FR-07
rows.text: A stable content hash is computed; identical text may be submitted repeatedly.

rows.id: pe:requirement:FR-08
rows.title: FR-08
rows.text: Evaluate spelling, grammar, articles, verb tense, word choice, punctuation, and clarity in English Passages only.

rows.id: pe:requirement:FR-09
rows.title: FR-09
rows.text: Corrections keep technical meaning and intended tone, and leave non-English text unchanged.

rows.id: pe:requirement:FR-10
rows.title: FR-10
rows.text: Every Evaluation has an integer score 0–100, its band, and Findings carrying one approved category, one approved severity, original text, Correction, and explanation.

rows.id: pe:requirement:FR-11
rows.title: FR-11
rows.text: Zero Findings is a valid Evaluation and states that no correction is needed.

rows.id: pe:requirement:FR-12
rows.title: FR-12
rows.text: Provider, model, Rubric Version, and evaluated English word count are retained and shown.

rows.id: pe:requirement:FR-13
rows.title: FR-13
rows.text: Stored records are immutable — readable and deletable only.

rows.id: pe:requirement:FR-14
rows.title: FR-14
rows.text: History lists Evaluations newest first with date, summary, score, and band.

rows.id: pe:requirement:FR-15
rows.title: FR-15
rows.text: Opening a record shows original text, corrected text, all Findings, all Suggestions, and context.

rows.id: pe:requirement:FR-16
rows.title: FR-16
rows.text: Identical text submitted twice creates two separately addressable records.

rows.id: pe:requirement:FR-17
rows.title: FR-17
rows.text: Progress covers last 7 days, last 30 days, and all compatible history.

rows.id: pe:requirement:FR-18
rows.title: FR-18
rows.text: Finding Rate is the primary measure and shows its underlying counts.

rows.id: pe:requirement:FR-19
rows.title: FR-19
rows.text: Category Recurrence counts each sample once per category; recurring Corrections link phrase to Corrections.

rows.id: pe:requirement:FR-20
rows.title: FR-20
rows.text: Every Progress Insight reveals the exact source Findings behind it.

rows.id: pe:requirement:FR-21
rows.title: FR-21
rows.text: Finding Rate is labeled primary, score secondary, raw counts descriptive; values recompute from retained rows.

rows.id: pe:requirement:FR-22
rows.title: FR-22
rows.text: History shows each Rubric Version; Progress defaults to the current one and never merges undeclared-incompatible versions.

rows.id: pe:requirement:FR-23
rows.title: FR-23
rows.text: Retain the approved fields only. Never persist API keys, hidden reasoning, or raw HTTP bodies. See [`DATA-POLICY.md`](./DATA-POLICY.md).

rows.id: pe:requirement:FR-24
rows.title: FR-24
rows.text: Disclose local data location, receiving provider, separate provider retention, and the loopback-only rule.

rows.id: pe:requirement:FR-25
rows.title: FR-25
rows.text: Deliberate deletion removes one Evaluation with its sample, Findings, Suggestions, and metadata; Progress recalculates.

rows.id: pe:requirement:FR-26
rows.title: FR-26
rows.text: Protected Technical Content produces no Findings, is excluded from scoring, and is preserved byte-for-byte.

rows.id: pe:requirement:FR-27
rows.title: FR-27
rows.text: A sample with no meaning-bearing English Passage is rejected and stored nowhere.

rows.id: pe:requirement:FR-28
rows.title: FR-28

rows.id: pe:requirement:FR-29

rows.id: pe:requirement:QR-02

rows.id: pe:rubric:english-word-count:01
rows.title: Rubric Version 1 > English word count
rows.text: Count only after Protected Technical Content and model-identified non-English spans are excluded.

rows.id: pe:rubric:english-word-count:02
rows.title: Rubric Version 1 > English word count
rows.text: A word is one maximal run of Unicode letters and combining marks. An internal apostrophe (ASCII or curly) or hyphen (ASCII or non-breaking) keeps the word whole only when letters sit on both sides.

rows.id: pe:rubric:english-word-count:03
rows.title: Rubric Version 1 > English word count
rows.text: Contractions, possessives, hyphenated compounds, letter-only acronyms: 1.

rows.id: pe:rubric:english-word-count:04
rows.title: Rubric Version 1 > English word count
rows.text: Standalone numbers, punctuation, emoji, protected identifiers: 0.

rows.id: pe:rubric:english-word-count:05
rows.title: Rubric Version 1 > English word count
rows.text: Case and surrounding whitespace are irrelevant.

rows.id: pe:rubric:error-categories:01
rows.title: Rubric Version 1 > Error Categories
rows.text: Exactly one per Finding, from this fixed list. The evaluator cannot invent categories.

rows.id: pe:rubric:error-categories:02
rows.title: Rubric Version 1 > Error Categories
rows.text: Spelling | A word is misspelled or malformed. Do not claim intent proves it was a typo.

rows.id: pe:rubric:error-categories:03
rows.title: Rubric Version 1 > Error Categories
rows.text: Article | `a`, `an`, or `the` is missing, unnecessary, or incorrect.

rows.id: pe:rubric:error-categories:04
rows.title: Rubric Version 1 > Error Categories
rows.text: Verb form/tense | Wrong tense, aspect, auxiliary, conjugation, or subject–verb agreement.

rows.id: pe:rubric:error-categories:05
rows.title: Rubric Version 1 > Error Categories
rows.text: Preposition | A preposition is missing, unnecessary, or incorrect.

rows.id: pe:rubric:error-categories:06
rows.title: Rubric Version 1 > Error Categories
rows.text: Word choice | A word is demonstrably wrong or forms an invalid collocation. If choosing among valid words needs unstated intent, use a Suggestion.

rows.id: pe:rubric:error-categories:07
rows.title: Rubric Version 1 > Error Categories
rows.text: Grammar/syntax | Structure, pronoun use, or number agreement is wrong and no narrower category applies.

rows.id: pe:rubric:error-categories:08
rows.title: Rubric Version 1 > Error Categories
rows.text: Punctuation/capitalization | Punctuation or letter case is incorrect.

rows.id: pe:rubric:error-categories:09
rows.title: Rubric Version 1 > Error Categories
rows.text: Clarity | The text itself prevents a reasonable reader from recovering the meaning. Not for optional rewrites, verbosity, tone, or elegance.

rows.id: pe:rubric:error-categories:10
rows.title: Rubric Version 1 > Error Categories
rows.text: Other | A real problem fitting nothing above. Rare; explain why.

rows.id: pe:rubric:error-categories:11
rows.title: Rubric Version 1 > Error Categories
rows.text: Precedence when a problem fits several — first applicable rule wins:

rows.id: pe:rubric:error-categories:12
rows.title: Rubric Version 1 > Error Categories
rows.text: Spelling or Punctuation/capitalization for observable mechanics.

rows.id: pe:rubric:error-categories:13
rows.title: Rubric Version 1 > Error Categories
rows.text: Article, Verb form/tense, or Preposition.

rows.id: pe:rubric:error-categories:14
rows.title: Rubric Version 1 > Error Categories
rows.text: Word choice for lexical meaning or collocation.

rows.id: pe:rubric:error-categories:15
rows.title: Rubric Version 1 > Error Categories
rows.text: Grammar/syntax for remaining structural grammar.

rows.id: pe:rubric:error-categories:16
rows.title: Rubric Version 1 > Error Categories
rows.text: Clarity only when the text blocks interpretation.

rows.id: pe:rubric:error-categories:17
rows.title: Rubric Version 1 > Error Categories
rows.text: Other.

rows.id: pe:rubric:error-categories:18
rows.title: Rubric Version 1 > Error Categories
rows.text: Never duplicate one problem across categories. Separate Findings are fine when one phrase holds distinct problems (missing preposition *and* wrong verb form).

rows.id: pe:rubric:finding-severity:01
rows.title: Rubric Version 1 > Finding Severity
rows.text: Severity describes the error's effect in its actual passage. Category never determines severity — a Spelling error can be Minor or Major.

rows.id: pe:rubric:finding-severity:02
rows.title: Rubric Version 1 > Finding Severity
rows.text: Minor | Local; meaning stays clear with little interruption.

rows.id: pe:rubric:finding-severity:03
rows.title: Rubric Version 1 > Finding Severity
rows.text: Moderate | Reading is interrupted, but meaning is recoverable without guesswork.

rows.id: pe:rubric:finding-severity:04
rows.title: Rubric Version 1 > Finding Severity
rows.text: Major | Meaning becomes wrong, obscured, or hard to recover.

rows.id: pe:rubric:findings-and-suggestions:01
rows.title: Rubric Version 1 > Findings and Suggestions
rows.text: A **Finding** is a demonstrable error. It gets one Error Category and one Finding Severity, contributes to the corrected version, and affects the score and Progress Insights.

rows.id: pe:rubric:findings-and-suggestions:02
rows.title: Rubric Version 1 > Findings and Suggestions
rows.text: A **Suggestion** is an optional alternative where correctness depends on unstated context or intended nuance. It has no category, no severity, and no effect on corrected text, score, band, or any Progress Insight. It must state that the original is not confirmed wrong and name the missing context.

rows.id: pe:rubric:findings-and-suggestions:03
rows.title: Rubric Version 1 > Findings and Suggestions
rows.text: If uncertain whether text is erroneous, do not create a Finding. Omit it, or create a Suggestion.

rows.id: pe:rubric:progress-insights:01
rows.title: Rubric Version 1 > Progress Insights
rows.text: Only successful, retained Evaluations contribute. Suggestions never enter any calculation. Deleted Evaluations vanish from recalculated insights; repeated Writing Samples stay separate observations.

rows.id: pe:rubric:progress-insights:02
rows.title: Rubric Version 1 > Progress Insights
rows.text: **Primary — Finding Rate:** `Findings / evaluated English words × 100`. Lower is better within one compatible version. Always shown with its Evaluation, word, and Finding counts.

rows.id: pe:rubric:progress-insights:03
rows.title: Rubric Version 1 > Progress Insights
rows.text: **Habit — Category Recurrence:** `samples containing the category / evaluated samples × 100`. Count each sample once per category.

rows.id: pe:rubric:progress-insights:04
rows.title: Rubric Version 1 > Progress Insights
rows.text: **Secondary — average Overall Score.** Model variation makes it weaker evidence than Finding Rate.

rows.id: pe:rubric:progress-insights:05
rows.title: Rubric Version 1 > Progress Insights
rows.text: **Descriptive:** raw Finding count, distribution by category, frequently corrected phrases with their Corrections, Evaluation and word counts.

rows.id: pe:rubric:progress-insights:06
rows.title: Rubric Version 1 > Progress Insights
rows.text: Windows: last 7 days, last 30 days, all compatible history. Each shows its Evaluation count. Progress defaults to the current Rubric Version and segments incompatible versions instead of merging them.

rows.id: pe:rubric:progress-insights:07
rows.title: Rubric Version 1 > Progress Insights
rows.text: No period is ever labeled "improved" or "declined" — the MVP shows values and evidence only, so it needs no minimum sample size. Adding directional claims later requires defining and validating that threshold first.

rows.id: pe:rubric:rubric-version-1:01
rows.title: Rubric Version 1
rows.text: Evaluation policy: what gets assessed, how Findings are classified, how the score is derived, and when two Evaluations may be compared. Vocabulary is defined in `CONTEXT.md`.

rows.id: pe:rubric:rubric-version-1:02
rows.title: Rubric Version 1
rows.text: Rubric Version is immutable on a stored Evaluation. Versions are incompatible by default; combining them in Progress requires an explicit code-level compatibility declaration. Changing provider, model, reasoning config, structured contract, prompt, word-count rule, or score formula defaults to a new incompatible version. Historical rows are never rewritten.

rows.id: pe:rubric:scope:01
rows.title: Rubric Version 1 > Scope
rows.text: Assess the English writing in one Writing Sample — never prompt effectiveness, instruction quality, task design, or likely model performance.

rows.id: pe:rubric:scope:02
rows.title: Rubric Version 1 > Scope
rows.text: Only English Passages are evaluated. Non-English text stays byte-for-byte unchanged and affects no score, Finding, or Progress Insight.

rows.id: pe:rubric:scope:03
rows.title: Rubric Version 1 > Scope
rows.text: A sample with no meaning-bearing English Passage is rejected; no Evaluation is stored.

rows.id: pe:rubric:scope:04
rows.title: Rubric Version 1 > Scope
rows.text: Protected Technical Content (fenced/inline code, structured data, commands, paths, identifiers, logs) is excluded from scoring and Findings, and preserved byte-for-byte in the corrected version.

rows.id: pe:rubric:scope:05
rows.title: Rubric Version 1 > Scope
rows.text: Quotation marks and Markdown blockquotes protect nothing. English inside them is evaluated normally; only Protected Technical Content is excluded.

rows.id: pe:rubric:scope:06
rows.title: Rubric Version 1 > Scope
rows.text: Judge concise technical prose in its intended context, not as formal prose.

rows.id: pe:rubric:scope:07
rows.title: Rubric Version 1 > Scope
rows.text: Never penalize one valid formulation because another could be preferable.
